requests.subject: Original fictional adaptive desk lamp with flat graphite circular head, brass hinge and graphite stem/base on a warm ivory desktop.
requests.purpose: Establish the product silhouette and a quiet launch mood.
requests.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: presentation photo/illustration layer; 16:9 composition.
Primary request: Original fictional adaptive desk lamp with flat graphite circular head, brass hinge and graphite stem/base on a warm ivory desktop.
Purpose: Establish the product silhouette and a quiet launch mood.
Style/medium: Professional editorial photography with believable materials and controlled lighting.
Composition/framing: Subject on the right 45%; quiet negative space across the left 50% for native slide text.
Color palette: background #F4F3EE, ink #202623, restrained accent #B0772A.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, chart labels or invented data; leave all slide typography native.
Identity: original fictional subject; do not imitate a named real product or venue.
